en: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky #MON, ISITSUBUTE!
et: Aih! Ma komistasin kivise #MON otsa, see on Geodude

label: _Route4BattleText1
en: I came to get my mushroom #MON!
et: Ma tulin siia, et võtta oma seene #MON!

label: _Route4AfterBattleText1
en: There might not be any more mushrooms here.
et: Siin ei pruugi ühtegi seent alles olla.

label: _Route4AfterBattleText1
en: I think I got them all.
et: Ma vist korjasin nad kõik ära.

label: _Route5Text1
en: UNDERGROUND PATH HANADA CITY KUCHIBA CITY
et: MAAALUNE TEE HANADA LINN KUCHIBA LINN

label: _Route6BattleText1
en: Who's there? Quit listening in on us!
et: Kes seal on? Lõpeta meie pealtkuulamine!

label: _Route6BattleText2
en: Excuse me! This is a private conversation!
et: Vabandage aga see vestlus on privaatne!

label: _Route6BattleText3
en: There aren't many bugs out here.

label: _Route6AfterBattleText3
en: I like bugs, so I'm going back to TOKIWA FOREST.
et: Mulle meeldivad putukad, seega lähen TOKIWA METSA!

label: _Route6BattleText4
en: Huh? You want to talk to me?

label: _Route6AfterBattleText4
en: I should carry more #MON with me for safety.
et: Julgeoleku kaalutlusel peaksin rohkem #MON endaga kaasas kandma.

label: _Route6AfterBattleText5
en: I want to get stronger! What's your secret?
et: Ma tahan saada tugevamaks! Mis on su saladus!

label: _Route6BattleText6
en: I've never seen you around! Are you good?
et: Ma pole sind varem näinud! Oled sa osav?

label: _Route6AfterBattleText6
en: Are my #MON weak? Or, am I just bad?
et: Kas mu #MON on nõrgad? Või ma olen lihtsalt koba?

label: _Route6Text7
en: UNDERGROUND PATH HANADA CITY KUCHIBA CITY
et: MAAALUNE TEE HANADA LINN KUCHIBA LINN

label: _Route7Text1
en: UNDERGROUND PATH TAMAMUSHI CITY CION TOWN
et: MAAALUNE TEE TAMAMUSHI LINN CION KÜLA

label: _Route8BattleText1
en: You look good at #MON, but how's your chemistry grade?
et: Sa tundub olema #MONidega osav aga kuidas sa keemias oled?

label: _Route8AfterBattleText1
en: I am better at school than this!
et: Mul läheb koolis paremini kui sellega siin!

label: _Route8BattleText2
en: All right! Let's roll the dice!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText2
en: Lady Luck's not with me today!

label: _Route8BattleText3
en: You need strategy to win at this!
et: Sa pead mõtlema, kui tahad võita!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText3
et: Kõigepealt alusta GRIMERiga... siis... ja siis ....

label: _Route8BattleText4
en: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!
et: Mulle meeldib NIDORAN, seega ma kogun neid!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText4
en: When #MON grow up they get ugly! They shouldn't evolve!
et: Kui #MONi kasvavad suureks, siis nad pole enam armsad! Nad ei tohiks areneda!

label: _Route8BattleText5
en: School is fun, but so are #MON.
et: Kool on küll tore aga nii on ka #MONid.

label: _Route8AfterBattleText5
en: We're stuck here because of the gates at YAMABUKI.
et: Me oleme siin kinni YAMABUKI väravate pärast.

label: _Route8BattleText6
en: NYARTH is so cute, meow, meow, meow!
et: MEOWTH on nii nunnu, mjäu mjäu, mjäu!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText6
en: I think POPPO and KORATTA are cute too!
et: PIDGEY ja RATTATA on ka armsad!

label: _Route8BattleText7
en: We must look silly standing here like this!
et: Me vist näeme sedasi siin passides totrad välja!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText7
en: YAMABUKI's gate keeper won't let us through. He's so mean!
et: YAMABUKI väravavaht ei lase kedagi läbi. Ta on nii õel!

label: _Route8BattleText8
et: Ma olen täiega maru mängu kutt!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText8
en: Gambling and #MON are like eating peanuts! Just can't stop!
et: Mängud ja #MONid on nagu pähklid! Ma ei saa lihtsalt pidama!

label: _Route8BattleText9
en: What's a cute, round and fluffy #MON?
et: Mis on armas, ümar ja karvane #MON?

label: _Route8EndBattleText9
en: Don't be so mean to my PIPPI!
et: Ära ole mu CLEFAIRY vastu nii õel!

label: _Route8AfterBattleText9
en: I heard that PIPPI evolves when it's exposed to a MOON STONE.
et: Ma kuulsin, et CLEFAIRY areneb, kui talle anda KUUKIVI.

label: _Route8Text10
en: UNDERGROUND PATH TAMAMUSHI CITY CION TOWN
et: MAAALUNE TEE TAMAMUSHI LINN CION KÜLA

label: _Route9BattleText1
en: You have #MON with you! You're mine!
et: Sul on #MONe! Nüüd sa oled minu!

label: _Route9AfterBattleText1
en: You need light to get through that dark tunnel ahead.
et: Ainult valgusega saad sellest pimedast tunnelist läbi.

label: _Route9BattleText2
en: Who's that walking with those good looking #MON?
et: No kes seal kõnnib nende ilusate #MONidega?

label: _Route9BattleText3
en: I'm taking ROCK TUNNEL to go to CION...
et: Ma läen läbi KIVI TUNNELI CIONI...

label: _Route9AfterBattleText3
en: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL too?
et: Kas sa lähed ka KIVI TUNNELISSE?

label: _Route9BattleText4
et: Ära sa katsugi mulle ülevalt alla vaadata!

label: _Route9AfterBattleText4
en: You're obviously talented! Good luck to you!
et: Üsna ilmselt sa oled väga andekas! Edu!

label: _Route9BattleText5
en: Bwahaha! Great! I was bored, eh!
et: Muahahaha! Tore! Ma olingi igavusse suremas!

label: _Route9AfterBattleText5
en: You sure had guts standing up to me there, eh?
et: On sul ikka südikust, et mulle vastu astuda!

label: _Route9BattleText6
en: Hahaha! Aren't you a little toughie!
et: Hahahaha! Kas sa pole mitte üks pisike karm kutt!

label: _Route9BattleText7
en: I got up early every day to raise my #MON from cocoons!
et: Ma tõusin igal hommikul vara üles, et mu #MONid kookonitest üles kasvatada!

label: _Route9EndBattleText7
en: What a total waste of time!

label: _Route9AfterBattleText7
en: I have to collect more than bugs to get stronger...
et: Ma pean rohkemat, kui ainult putukaid koguma, et tugevaks saada...

label: _Route9AfterBattleText9
en: If you don't like bug #MON, you bug me!
et: Kui sulle putukad ei meeldi, siis ei meeldi sa mulle!

label: _SSAnne1Text1
en: Bonjour! I am le waiter on this ship!
et: Bonjour! Ma olen le kelner siin laevas!

label: _SSAnne1Text1
en: I will be happy to serve you anything you please!
et: Ma pakun teile hea meelega midaiganes te soovite!

label: _SSAnne1Text2
en: You might be challenged by the more bored ones!

label: _SSAnne8BattleText1
en: I travel alone on my journeys!

label: _SSAnne8AfterBattleText1
en: You should be nice to friends!

label: _SSAnne8BattleText2
en: You pup! How dare you barge in!
et: Sina kutsikas! Kuidas Sa julged vahele segada!

label: _SSAnne8AfterBattleText2
en: I wish to be left alone! Get out!
et: Ma tahan, et te jätaksite mind rahule! Kaduge välja!

label: _SSAnne8AfterBattleText3
en: Let me be your friend, OK?
et: Luba ma olen Su sõber, palun?

label: _SSAnne8BattleText4
en: I collected these #MON from all around the world!
et: Ma kogusin need #MONid kokku üle maailma!

label: _SSAnne8EndBattleText4
en: Oh no! I went around the world for these!
et: Oh ei! Ma otsisin neid kõikjalt!

label: _SSAnne8AfterBattleText4
et: Sa tegid haiget mu vaesele maailma näinud #MONidele!

label: _SSAnne8AfterBattleText4
en: I demand that you heal them at a #MON CENTER!
et: Ma nõuan, et Sa raviksid nad #MON KESKUSES!

label: _SSAnne8Text5
en: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie please!

label: _SSAnne8Text6
en: A cruise is so elegant yet cozy!
et: See kruiis on nii elegantne ja hubane!

label: _SSAnne8Text9
en: We are cruising around the world.

label: _SSAnne8Text11
en: Ssh! I'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent!
et: Tasa! Ma olen GLOBAALSE POLITSEI agent!

label: _SSAnne8Text11
en: I'm on the trail of ROCKET GANG!

label: _SSAnne2Text1
en: This ship, she is a luxury liner for trainers!
et: See laev on luksuslik lainer treeneritele!

label: _SSAnne2Text1
en: At every port, we hold parties with invited trainers!
et: Igas sadamas me peame pidu kõigi kutsutud treeneritega!

label: _SSAnneRivalBeforeBattleText
et: Mul on juba 40 erinevat kinni püütud, semu!

label: _SSAnneRivalWonText
et: Sa võiksid tõesti ennast käsile võtta, semu!

label: _SSAnneRivalCaptainText
en: <RIVAL>: I heard there was a IAI CUT master on board.
et: <RIVAL>: Ma kuulsin, et KIIRE LÕIKE meister on ka pardal.

label: _SSAnneRivalCaptainText
en: But, he was just a seasick, old man!
et: Aga see oli lihtsalt mingi merehaige vanamees!

label: _SSAnneRivalCaptainText
en: But, IAI CUT itself is really useful!
et: Aga KIIRE LÕIGE on iseenesest väga kasulik!

label: _SSAnneRivalCaptainText
en: You should go see him! Smell ya!
et: Sa peaks teda vaatama minema! Nägudeni!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61bf2
en: In all my travels I've never seen any #MON sleep like this one!
et: Ma pole ühelgi oma reisil näinud kunagi ühtegi #MONi nii magamas!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c01
en: Ah yes, I have seen some #MON ferry people across the water!
et: Ahjaa, ma olen näinud mõningaid #MONe ka inimesi sõidutamas üle vee!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c10
en: #MON can IAI CUT down small bushes.
et: #MON saab KIIRE LÕIKEGA maha võtta väikseid põõsaid.

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c1f
en: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE in SEKICHIKU CITY?
et: Oled Sa käinud FUCHSIA LINNA SAFARI ALAS?

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c1f
en: It had many rare kinds of #MON!!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c2e
en: Me and my Daddy think the SAFARI ZONE is awesome!
et: Mina ja minu Isa arvame, et SAFARI ALA on äge!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c3d
en: The CAPTAIN looked really sick and pale!
et: KAPTEN nägi välja tõsiselt haige ja kahvatu!

label: _SSAnne9Text_61c4c
en: I hear many people get seasick!
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et paljud inimesed jäävad merehaigeks!

label: _SSAnne9BattleText1
en: Competing against the young keeps me youthful.

label: _SSAnne9EndBattleText1
en: Good fight! Ah, I feel young again!
et: Hea võitlus! Ah, ma tunnen end jälle noorena!

label: _SSAnne9AfterBattleText1
en: 15 years ago, I would have won!

label: _SSAnne9BattleText2
en: Check out what I fished up!

label: _SSAnne9AfterBattleText2
en: The cruise ship's party should be over by now.
et: Kruiisika pidu peaks praeguseks läbi olema.

label: _SSAnne9BattleText3
en: Which do you like, a strong or a rare #MON?
et: Kumb Sulle meeldib, tugev või haruldane #MON?

label: _SSAnne9BattleText4
en: I never saw you at the party.
et: Ma pole varem Sind siinsetel pidudel näinud.

label: _SSAnne3Text1
en: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master!

label: _SSAnne3Text1
en: He even teaches IAI CUT to #MON!

label: _SSAnne10BattleText1
en: You know what they say about sailors and fighting!
et: Tead ju küll, mida nad arvad meremestest ja võitlusest!

label: _SSAnne10AfterBattleText1
en: Haha! Want to be a sailor, mate?

label: _SSAnne10BattleText2
en: My sailor's pride is at stake!

label: _SSAnne10AfterBattleText2
en: Did you see the FISHING GURU in KUCHIBA CITY?

label: _SSAnne10BattleText4
en: I like feisty kids like you!
et: Mulle meeldivad tormakad lapsed nagu Sina!@

label: _SSAnne10AfterBattleText4
en: Sea #MON live in deep water. You'll need a ROD!
et: Mere #MONid elavad sügavas vees. Sul on vaja ÕNGE!

label: _SSAnne10BattleText5
en: Matey, you're walking the plank if you lose!
et: Sõbrake, Sa kõnnid plangule, kui kaotad!

label: _SSAnne10AfterBattleText5
en: Jellyfish sometimes drift into the ship.

label: _SSAnne10BattleText6
en: All my #MON are from the sea!

label: _SSAnne10EndBattleText6
en: Darn! I let that one get away!

label: _SSAnne10AfterBattleText6
en: I was going to make you my assistant too!
et: Ma pidin Sinust kah oma assistendi tegema!

label: _SSAnne10Text7
en: My buddy, GORIKY, is super strong!
et: Mu sõps, MACHOKE, on väga tugev!

label: _SSAnne10Text7
en: He has enough STRENGTH to move big rocks!
et: Tal on piisavalt JÕUDU liigutada suuri kivimürakaid.

label: _SSAnne5Text1
en: The party's over. The ship will be departing soon.
et: Pidu on läbi. Laev lahkub peagi.

label: _SSAnne5Text3
en: I stepped out to get some air.

label: _SSAnne5AfterBattleText1
en: How many kinds of #MON do you think there are?
et: Mis Sa arvad, kui palju erinevaid #MONe on kokku?

label: _SSAnne5AfterBattleText2
en: My Pa said there are 100 kinds of #MON. I think there are more.
et: Mu isa ütles, et on 100 erinevat #MONi. Ma arvan, et on rohkem.

label: _SSAnne7RubText
en: CAPTAIN: Ooargh... I feel hideous... Urrp! Seasick...
et: KAPTEN: Oaa... Ma tunnen end halvasti! Upp! Merehaigus...

label: _ReceivingHM01Text
en: CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you! I feel much better!
et: KAPTEN: Huuh! Aitäh! Ma tunnen end palju paremini!

label: _ReceivingHM01Text
en: You want to see my IAI CUT technique?
et: Tahad näha mu KIIRE LÕIKE võtet?

label: _ReceivingHM01Text
en: I could show you if I wasn't ill...
et: Ma näitaks Sulle, kui mul poleks nii paha...

label: _ReceivingHM01Text
en: I know! You can have this!
et: Ma tean! Sa võid selle endale saada!

label: _ReceivingHM01Text
en: Teach it to your #MON and you can see it IAI CUT any time!
et: Õpeta seda oma #MONile, ja näe kuidas ta KIIRELT LÕIKAB.

label: _SSAnne7Text_61932
en: Now that I'm not sick any more, I guess it's time.
et: Nüüd, mil ma pole enam haige, ma arvan, et on aeg.

label: _HM01NoRoomText
en: Oh no! You have no room for this!
et: Oh ei! Sul pole piisavalt ruumi!

label: _SSAnne7Text3
en: How to Conquer Seasickness... The CAPTAIN's reading this!
et: Kapten loeb raamatut nimega “Kuidas alistada merehaigus”...

label: _SSAnne6Text1
en: You, mon petit! We're busy here! Out of the way!
et: Sina mon petit! Meil on kiire! Eest ära!

label: _SSAnne6Text2
en: I saw an odd ball in the trash.
et: Ma nägin üht imelikku palli prügikastis.

label: _SSAnne6Text3
en: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!
et: Mul on nii kiire, et pea käib ringi!

label: _SSAnne6Text4
en: I peel spuds every day! Hum-hum...
et: Ma koorin kartuleid iga päev! Tut-tut-tuu...

label: _SSAnne6Text5
en: All it does is eat and sleep!

label: _SSAnne6Text6
en: I only get to peel onions... Snivel...
et: Ma haistan ainult kooritud sibulaid... nuuks...

label: _SSAnne6Text_61807
en: Er-hem! Indeed I am le CHEF!
et: Mhm! Ma tõesti olen le KOKK!

label: _SSAnne6Text_6180c
en: Les guests may gripe it's fish again, however!
et: Külalised võivad küll viriseda, et jälle kala, kuid mis parata!

label: _SSAnne6Text_61811
en: Les guests will mutiny, I fear.
et: Ma kardan, et külalised hakkavad mässama.

label: _SSAnne6Text_61816
en: But, have I enough fillets du beef?
et: On mul piisavalt fileed, et seda teha?

label: _SafariZoneCenterText3
en: Press the START Button to check remaining time!
et: Vajuta START, et kontrollida järelejäänud aega!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse1Text1
en: I said I'd meet him here.
et: Ma leppisin temaga kokku, et kohtume siin.

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse1Text2
en: I'm catching #MON to take home as gifts!
et: Ma püüan #MONe, et viia koju kingiks!

label: _SafariZoneEastText6
en: The remaining time declines only while you walk!
et: Aeg tiksub maha ainult siis, kui jalutad!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse3Text1
en: How many did you catch? I'm bushed from the work!
et: Kui palju sa püüdsid? Ma olen kogu sellest tööst väsind!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse3Text3
en: Whew! I'm tired from all the fun!
et: Huuh! Mul on kogu sellest lõbust väss!

label: SafariZoneEntranceText_9e6e4
en: For just ¥500, you can catch all the #MON you want in the park!
et: Ainult ¥500 eest võid siin pargis #MONe püüda nii palju kui jaksad!

label: SafariZoneEntranceText_9e6e4
en: Would you like to join the hunt?

label: SafariZoneEntranceText_9e747
en: We only use a special MONSTER BALL here.
et: Me kasutame siin erilisi KOLLI PALLE.

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_75360
en: We'll call you on the PA when you run out of time or SAFARI BALLs!
et: Me teavitame sind valjuhääldiga, kui sul saavad otsa pallid või aeg!

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_7536a
et: Oi oi! Sul pole piisavalt raha!

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753bb
en: Please return any SAFARI BALLs you have left.
et: Palun tagasta kõik SAFARI PALLID, mis sul kasutama jäid.

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753c5
en: Did you get a good haul? Come again!

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753e6
en: Hi! Is it your first time here?
et: Tere! Kas see on sul esimene kord siin?

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753eb
en: SAFARI ZONE has 4 zones in it.

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753eb
en: Each zone has different kinds of #MON. Use SAFARI BALLs to catch them!
et: Igas tsoonis on erinevad #MONid. Püüa neid SAFARI PALLIDEGA!

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753eb
en: When you run out of time or SAFARI BALLs, it's game over for you!
et: Kui sul saavad pallid otsa, siis on mäng läbi!

label: _SafariZoneEntranceText_753eb
en: Before you go, open an unused #MON BOX so there's room for new #MON!
et: Enne kui lähed, tee üks #MON kast vabaks uutele #MONidele!

label: _SafariZoneNorthText4
en: The SECRET HOUSE is still ahead!

label: _SafariZoneNorthText6
en: Zigzag through grassy areas to flush them out.
et: Kammi läbi kõik rohused alad, et neid välja nuhkida.

label: _SafariZoneNorthText7
en: Win a free HM for finding the SECRET HOUSE!
et: Kui leiad SALAMAJA, siis saad auhinnaks TMi!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse4Text1
en: You can keep any item you find on the ground here.
et: Võid endale jätta kõik, mille leiad siit maast.

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse4Text1
en: But, you'll run out of time if you try for all of them at once!
et: Aga kui üritad neid kõike üles leida korraga, jooksed ajast tühjaks!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse4Text2
en: Go to the deepest part of the SAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!
et: Mine SAFARI ALA kõige kaugemasse nurka. Võidad siis auhinna!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse4Text3
en: But, a friend's EIEVUI turned into a SHOWERS! I wonder why?
et: Aga mu sõbra EEVEE arenes VAPOREONiks! Huvitav miks?

label: _SecretHouseText_4a350
en: You're the first person to reach the SECRET HOUSE!
et: Sa oled esimene, kes leidis üles SALAMAJA!

label: _SecretHouseText_4a350
en: I was getting worried that no one would win our campaign prize.
et: Ma juba hakkasin muretsema, et keegi ei võidagi meie auhinda!

label: _HM03ExplanationText
en: #MON will be able to ferry you across water!
et: #MON saab sind selle abil sõidutada üle vee!

label: _HM03ExplanationText
en: And, this HM isn't disposable! You can use it over and over!
et: Ning, seda HMi saad kasutada jälle ja jälle!

label: _HM03ExplanationText
en: You're super lucky for winning this fabulous prize!
et: Sul on väga vedanud, et oled võitnud selle imelise auhinna!

label: _HM03NoRoomText
en: You don't have room for this fabulous prize!
et: Sul pole ruumi selle auhinna jaoks!

label: _SafariZoneWestText6
en: Please find the SAFARI WARDEN's lost GOLD TEETH. They're around here somewhere.
et: Palun leida SAFARI VALVURI KULD HAMBAD. Nad peaks siin kuskil olema.

label: _SafariZoneWestText7
en: The Search for the SECRET HOUSE!

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse2Text1
en: Tossing ROCKs at #MON might make them run, but they'll be easier to catch.
et: Pildudes #MONe KIVIdega võib panna nad põgenema aga neid võib olla ka lihtsam püüda.

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse2Text2
en: Using BAIT will make #MON easier to catch.

label: _SafariZoneRestHouse2Text3
en: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any #MON I wanted.
et: Jalutasin palju aga ei näinud ühtegi #MONi mida ma oleks tahtnud.

label: _SaffronCityText1
en: What do you want? Get lost!

label: _SaffronCityText2
en: BOSS said he'll take this town!
et: BOSS ütles, et ta võtab selle linna endale!

label: _SaffronCityText5
en: Being evil makes me feel so alive!
et: Kuri olla on vahva! Ma tunnen end nii elusana!

label: _SaffronCityText7
en: With SYLPH under control, we can exploit #MON around the world!
et: Kuna SYLPH on nüüd kontrolli all, saame #MON üle kogu maa kuritarvitada!

label: _SaffronCityText8
en: You beat ROCKET GANG all alone? That's amazing!
et: Sa said RAKETI KAMBAST üksi jagu? See on vinge!

label: _SaffronCityText9
en: Yeah! ROCKET GANG is gone! It's safe to go out again!
et: Jehuu! RAKETI KAMP on läinud! Nüüd on jälle turvaline välja tulla!

label: _SaffronCityText10
en: People should be flocking back to YAMABUKI now.
et: Inimesed peaks nüüd karja jooksma YAMABUKI LINNA.

label: _SaffronCityText11
en: I flew here on my PIGEOT when I read about SYLPH.
et: Ma lendasin siia oma PIGEOTiga, kui lugesin SYLPHist.

label: _SaffronCityText11
en: It's already over? I missed the media action.
et: Juba läbi vä? Jäin kõigest ilma.

label: _SaffronCityText13
en: I saw ROCKET BOSS escaping SYLPH's building.
et: Ma nägin kuidas RAKETI KAMP põgenes SYLPHI peakontorist.

label: _SaffronCityText14
en: Suspicious kids I don't allow in!
et: Kahtlasi tegelasi, ka lapsi, ma sisse ei lase!

label: _SaffronCityText16
en: YAMABUKI CITY is the color of golden radiance.
et: YAMABUKI LINN on kuldse sära värvi.

label: _SaffronCityText20
en: FULL HEAL cures all ailments like sleep and burns.
et: ELUD TÄIS ravib kõik hädad nagu uni ja põletus.

label: _SaffronCityText20
en: It costs a bit more, but it's more convenient.
et: See maksab küll natuke rohkem, kuid on mugavam.

label: _SaffronCityText21
en: New SUPER BALL offers improved capture rates.
et: Uus SUPER PALL pakub paremat kinnipüüdmise võimalust.

label: _SaffronGateText_1dfe7
en: I'm on guard duty. Gee, I'm thirsty, though!
et: Ma olen hetkel valves. Huuh, janu on!

label: _SaffronGateText_1dfe7
en: Oh wait there, the road's closed.
et: Oi, oota siin, tee on suletud!

label: _SaffronGateText_8aaa9
en: Whoa, boy! I'm parched! ... Huh? I can have this drink? Gee, thanks!
et: Ossa poiss! Küll mul on kurk kuivab!

label: _SaffronGateText_1dff1
en: ... Glug glug... ... Gulp... If you want to go to YAMABUKI... ... You can go on through. I'll share this with the other guards!
et: ... Gull gull... ... Gull... If you want to go to YAMABUKI... ... You can go on through. I'll share this with the other guards!

label: _SaffronGateText_1dff6
en: Hi, thanks for the cool drinks!
et: Tere ja aitäh külma joogi eest!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d162
en: I had a vision of your arrival!
et: Ma nägin unesm, et sa saabud!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d162
en: I have had psychic powers since I was a child.
et: Mul on juba lapsest peale olnud selgelt nägija võimed.

label: _SaffronGymText_5d162
en: I first learned to bend spoons with my mind.
et: Kõigepealt ma õppisin lusikaid väänama oma mõtte jõuga.

label: _SaffronGymText_5d162
en: I dislike fighting, but if you wish, I will show you my powers!
et: Mulle ei meeldi võidelda aga kui sa soovid võin sulle oma võimeid vaadata!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d167
en: I'm shocked! But, a loss is a loss.
et: Olen šokeeritud! Aga, kaotus on kaotus.

label: _SaffronGymText_5d167
en: I admit I didn't work hard enough to win!
et: Tunnistan, et ma ei pingutanud väga võidu nimel!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d16e
en: Everyone has psychic power! People just don't realize it!
et: Kõigil on vaimseid võimaid! Inimesed tavaliselt ei pane seda tähele!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d173
en: The GOLDBADGE makes #MON up to L70 obey you!
et: KULDMÄRGI olemasolul kuuletuvad kuni 70 taseme #MONid sulle!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d173
en: Stronger #MON will become wild, ignoring your orders in battle!
et: Tugevamad #MONid hulluvad lahingus, ignoreerides su käsklusi!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d173
en: Just don't raise your #MON too much!
et: Ära siis liiga kiiresti oma #MONe kasvata!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d173
en: Wait, please take this TM with you!

label: _TM46ExplanationText
en: TM46 is PSYWAVE! It uses powerful psychic waves to inflict damage!
et: TM46 on VAIMULAINE! See võte kasutab tugevaid vaimseid lained!

label: _TM46NoRoomText
en: Your pack is full of other items!
et: Su kott on täis muid asju!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d1e6
en: NATSUME's #MON use psychic power instead of force!
et: NATSUME #MONid kasutavad vaimseid võimeid, toore jõu asemel!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d1e6
et: Võitlus #MONid on eriti haavatavad sellistele võtetele!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d1e6
en: They get creamed before they can even aim a punch!
et: Enne kui nad jõuvad oma lööki sihtimata hakata on juba mäng nende jaoks läbi!

label: _SaffronGymText_5d1eb
en: If I had that, I'd make a bundle at the slots!
et: Kui mul need oleks, siis ma oleks juba ammu nutsu kokku saanud mänguautomaatidega!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText1
en: NATSUME is younger than I, but I respect her!
et: NATSUME on minust küll noorem, kuid ma austan teda siiski!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText1
en: In a battle of equals, the one with the stronger will wins!
et: Võrdsete lahingus võidab see, kellel on tugevam vaim!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText1
en: If you wish to beat NATSUME, focus on winning!
et: Kui sa tahad NATSUMEt võita, pead keskenduma võidule!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText2
en: Does our unseen power scare you?
et: Kas meie ennenägematud võimed hirmutavad sind?

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText2
en: Psychic #MON fear only ghosts and bugs!
et: Vaimsed #MONid kardavad ainult kummitusi ja putukaid!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText3
en: #MON take on the appearance of their trainers.

label: _SaffronGymBattleText3
et: Sinu #MONid peaksid olema küll väga visad!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText3
en: I must teach better techniques to my #MON!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText4
en: You know that power alone isn't enough!
et: Sa ju tead, et võimust ainult ei piisa!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText4
en: NATSUME just wiped out the KARATE MASTER next door!
et: NATSUME just pühkis kõrval maja KARATE MEISTRIGA põrandat!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText5
en: You and I, our #MON shall fight!
et: Sina ja mina, meie #MONid nüüd võitlevad!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText5
en: I knew that this was going to take place.

label: _SaffronGymBattleText6
en: NATSUME is young, but she's also our LEADER!
et: NATSUME võib küll olla noor aga ta on meie JUHT!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText6
et: Sa ei pääse ta juurde nii lihtsalt!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText6
en: There used to be 2 #MON GYMs in YAMABUKI.
et: YAMABUKI linnas oli kunagi kaks #MONi saali.

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText6
en: The FIGHTING DOJO next door lost its GYM status when we went and creamed them!
et: VÕITLUS DOJO, kõrval majas, jäi oma saali staatusest ilma, kui me nendele koha kätte näitasime!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText7
en: YAMABUKI #MON GYM is famous for its psychics!
et: YAMABUKI #MONi saal on kuulus oma vaimsete treenerite tõttu!

label: _SaffronGymBattleText7
en: You want to see NATSUME! I can tell!
et: Ma näen su silmist, et tahad minna NATSUME juurde!

label: _SaffronGymAfterBattleText7
en: That's right! I used telepathy to read your mind!
et: Täpselt nii, ma kasutasin telepaatiat, et lugeda su mõtteid!

label: _SaffronMartText2
en: GOLD SPRAY lasts longer than SILVER SPRAY for keeping weaker #MON away!
et: #TÕRJE3 kestab kauem kui #TÕRJE2, et nõrke #MON eemal hoida!

label: _SaffronMartText3
en: REVIVE is costly, but it revives fainted #MON!
et: ELUSTA on küll kallis aga elustab minestanud #MONid!

label: _SaffronHouse1Text1
en: Thank you for writing. I hope to see you soon!
et: Tänan sind kirja eest. Loodan, et näen sind peadselt.

label: _SaffronHouse1Text1
en: Hey! Don't look at my letter!

label: _SaffronHouse1Text3
en: The MIMIC GIRL is cute! I'm getting her a PIPPI DOLL!
et: AHVI TÜDRUK on armas! Ma kingin talle PIPPI NUKU!

label: _SaffronHouse1Text4
en: I was given a PP UP as a gift.

label: _SaffronHouse1Text4
en: It's used for increasing the PP of techniques!
et: Selle abil saad taastada võtete PP!

label: _SaffronPokecenterText2
en: #MON growth rates differ from specie to specie.

label: _SaffronPokecenterText3
en: SYLPH CO. is very famous. That's why it attracted ROCKET GANG!
et: SYLPH on väga kuulus. Seepärast neid ründaski RAKETI KAMP!

label: _SeafoamIslands5Text4
en: Boulders might change the flow of water!

label: _SilphCo10Text_5a1d8
en: Please keep quiet about my crying!

label: _SilphCo10BattleText1
en: Welcome to the 10F! So good of you to join me!
et: Teretulemas 10. korrusele! Nii hea, et Sa liitusid!

label: _SilphCo10AfterBattleText1
en: Nice try, but the boardroom is up one more floor!
et: Hea üritus, kuid juhtkonnaruum on korrus ülalpool!

label: _SilphCo10AfterBattleText2
en: Are you satisfied with beating me? Then go on home!
et: Oled nüüd rahul? Mine nüüd koju!

label: _SilphCoPresidentText
en: PRESIDENT: Thank you for saving SYLPH!

label: _SilphCoPresidentText
en: I will never forget you saved us in our moment of peril!
et: Ma ei unusta kunagi, et Sa päästsid meid ohust!

label: _SilphCoPresidentText
en: I have to thank you in some way!
et: Ma pean ju Sind kuidagi tänama!

label: _SilphCoPresidentText
en: Because I am rich, I can give you anything!
et: Kuna ma olen rikas, võin Sulle anda midaiganes!

label: _SilphCo10Text_6231c
en: PRESIDENT: You can't buy that anywhere!
et: PRESIDENT: Seda ei saa kusagilt osta!

label: _SilphCo10Text_6231c
en: It's our secret prototype MASTER BALL!
et: See on meie salajane prototüüp MASTER BALL!

label: _SilphCo10Text_6231c
en: It will catch any #MON without fail!

label: _SilphCo10Text_6231c
en: You should be quiet about using it, though.

label: _SilphCoMasterBallNoRoomText
en: You have no room for this.

label: _SilphCo11Text2
en: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing all of us!
et: SEKRETÄR: Aitäh, et päästsid meid kõiki!

label: _SilphCo11Text3
en: The PRESIDENT and I are discussing a vital business proposition.

label: _SilphCo11Text3
en: Keep your nose out of grown-up matters...
et: Ära topi oma nina täiskasvanud asjadesse...

label: _SilphCo11Text3
en: Or, experience a world of pain!

label: _SilphCo10Text_62335
en: Blast it all! You ruined our plans for SYLPH!
et: Mingu ka kõik! Sa rikkusid meie plaanid SYLPHiga!

label: _SilphCo10Text_62335
en: But, ROCKET GANG will never fall!
et: Kuid RAKETI KAMP ei kaota kunagi!

label: _SilphCo10Text_62335
en: <PLAYER>! Never forget that all #MON exist for ROCKET GANG!
et: <PLAYER>! Ära unusta, et kõik #MONid on olemas vaid RAKETI KAMBA jaoks!

label: _SilphCo10Text_62335
en: I must go, but I shall return!
et: Ma pean minema, kuid ma tulen veel tagasi!

label: _SilphCo11BattleText1
en: Stop right there! Don't you move!

label: _SilphCo11AfterBattleText1
en: So, you want to see my BOSS?

label: _SilphCo11BattleText2
en: Halt! Do you have an appointment with my BOSS?
et: Seis! On Sul kohtumine kokkulepitud mu BOSSiga?

label: _SilphCo11AfterBattleText2
en: Watch your step, my BOSS likes his #MON tough!
et: Vaata ette, my BOSSile meeldivad oma visad #MONid!

label: _SilphCo1Text1
en: The PRESIDENT is in the boardroom on 11F!

label: _SilphCo2Text_59ded
en: Oh, you're not with ROCKET GANG. I thought... I'm sorry. Here, please take this!
et: Ah, Sa ei ole RAKETI KAMBAST. Ma arvasin... Vabandust. Näe, võta see!

label: _TM36ExplanationText
en: It's powerful, but the #MON that uses it faints! Be careful.
et: See on võimas, kuid #MON, kes seda kasutab, minestab. Ole ettevaatlik.

label: _TM36NoRoomText
en: You don't have any room for this.

label: _SilphCo2EndBattleText1
en: How did you know I was a ROCKET?
et: Kuidas Sa teadsid, et ma olen RAKETT?

label: _SilphCo2AfterBattleText1
en: I work for both SYLPH and ROCKET GANG!
et: Ma töötan nii SYLPHis kui ka RAKETI KAMBAS!

label: _SilphCo2BattleText2
en: It's off limits here! Go home!

label: _SilphCo2AfterBattleText2
en: Can you solve the maze in here?

label: _SilphCo2BattleText3
en: No kids are allowed in here!

label: _SilphCo2AfterBattleText3
en: Diamond shaped tiles are teleport blocks!
et: Teemanti kujulised plaadid on teleporti plaadid!

label: _SilphCo2BattleText4
en: Hey kid! What are you doing here?

label: _SilphCo2AfterBattleText4
en: SYLPH CO. will be merged with ROCKET GANG!

label: _SilphCo3Text_59ff9
en: I work for SYLPH. What should I do?
et: Ma töötan SYLPHis. Mis ma tegema pean?

label: _SilphCo3AfterBattleText1
en: A hint? You can open doors with a CARD KEY!
et: Vihjet tahad? Sa võid VÕTME KAARDIGA uksi avada!

label: _SilphCo3BattleText2
en: I support ROCKET GANG more than I support SYLPH!
et: Ma toetan RAKETI KAMPA rohkem kui SYLPHi!

label: _SilphCo3AfterBattleText2
en: ROCKET GANG said that if I helped them, they'd let me study #MON!
et: RAKETI KAMP ütles, et kui ma neid aitan, lasevad nad mul uurida #MONe!

label: _SilphCo4Text_19de0
en: Sssh! Can't you see I'm hiding?
et: Tššš! Kas Sa ei näe, et ma olen peidus?

label: _SilphCo4BattleText2
en: ROCKET GANG has taken command of SYLPH CO.!
et: RAKETI KAMP võttis SYLPHi juhtimise üle!

label: _SilphCo4AfterBattleText2
en: Fwahahaha! My BOSS has been after this place!
et: Hahahaa! Mu ÜLEMUS otsib seda kohta!

label: _SilphCo4AfterBattleText3
en: The doors are electronically locked! A CARD KEY opens them!
et: Ustel on elektrooniline lukk! VÕTME KAART avab need!

label: _SilphCo4AfterBattleText4
en: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!

label: _SilphCo5Text_1a010
en: ROCKET GANG is in an uproar over some intruder. That's you right?
et: RAKETI KAMP märatseb sissetungija pärast. Oled see Sina?

label: _SilphCo5Text_1a015
en: ROCKET GANG took off! You're our hero! Thank you!
et: RAKETI KAMP taandus! Sa oled kangelane! Aitäh!

label: _SilphCo5BattleText2
en: I heard a kid was wandering around.
et: Ma kuulsin, et mingi tatt jõlgub ringi.

label: _SilphCo5AfterBattleText2
en: It's not smart to pick a fight with ROCKET GANG!
et: RAKETI KAMBAGA kaklemine ei ole mõistlik!

label: _SilphCo5BattleText3
en: We study # BALL technology on this floor!

label: _SilphCo5AfterBattleText3
en: We worked on the ultimate # BALL which would catch anything!
et: Me töötasime selle ülima #BALL kallal, mis püüab kõik kinni!

label: _SilphCo5BattleText4
en: Whaaat? There shouldn't be any children here?

label: _SilphCo5AfterBattleText4
en: You're only on 5F. It's a long way to my BOSS!
et: Sa oled alles 5. korrusel. Sul on veel pikk tee minu BOSSINI!

label: _SilphCo5BattleText5
en: Show ROCKET GANG a little respect!
et: Näita natukene austust üles RAKETI KAMBA suhtes!

label: _SilphCo5Text9
en: #MON LAB created PORYGON, the first virtual reality #MON.

label: _SilphCo5Text11
en: 4 #MON evolve only when traded by link-cable.
et: 4 #MONi arenevad ainult kui neid vahetad üle kaabli.

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a24a
en: The ROCKETs came and took over the building!
et: RAKETid tulid ja võtsid maja üle!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a24f
en: Well, better get back to work!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a261
en: Oh dear, oh dear. Help me please!
et: Oi oi oi. Palun, aita mind!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a278
en: Look at him! He's such a coward!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a27d
en: I feel so sorry for him, I have to marry him!
et: Mul on nii kahju temast, ma pean temaga abielluma!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a28f
en: ROCKET GANG is trying to conquer the world with #MON!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a294
en: ROCKET GANG ran because of you!

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a2a6
en: They must have targeted SYLPH for our #MON products.
et: Nad ründasid SYLPHI meie #MON toodete tõttu.

label: _SilphCo6Text_1a2ab
en: Come work for SYLPH when you get older!
et: Tule SYLPHI tööle, kui vanemaks saad!

label: _SilphCo6BattleText2
en: I am one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
et: Ma olen üks neljast RAKETI VENNAST!

label: _SilphCo6AfterBattleText2
en: No matter! My brothers will avenge me!
et: Vahet pole! Mu vennad maksavad mulle kätte!

label: _SilphCo6BattleText3
en: He shouldn't have sent me to the TUNGUSKA BRANCH!
et: Ta poleks pidanud saatma mind TUNGUSKA HARUSSE!

label: _SilphCo6AfterBattleText3
en: TUNGUSKA BRANCH? It's deep in Russia!
et: TUNGUSKA HARU? See on sügaval Venemaal!

label: _SilphCo6AfterBattleText4
en: If you stand for justice, you betray evil!
et: Kui seisad õigluse eest, reedad kurjuse!

label: _MeetLaprasGuyText
en: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET! You came to save us? Why, thank you!
et: Oh! Tere! Sa pole RAKETT! Sa tulid päästma meid? Ei noh, aitäh!

label: _MeetLaprasGuyText
en: I want you to have this #MON for saving us.

label: _HeresYourLaprasText
et: See on LAPRAS. Ta on väga arukas.

label: _HeresYourLaprasText
en: We kept it in our lab, but it will be much better off with you!
et: Me hoidsime teda oma laboris, kuid tal on palju parem Sinuga!

label: _HeresYourLaprasText
en: I think you will be a good trainer for LAPLACE!
et: Ma usun, et Sa oled hea treener LAPRASELE!

label: _HeresYourLaprasText
en: It's a good swimmer. It'll give you a lift!
et: Ta on hea ujuja. Ta võib sind ringi sõidutada!

label: _LaprasGuyText
en: ROCKET GANG's BOSS went to the boardroom! Is our PRESIDENT OK?
et: RAKETI KAMBA BOSS läks juhtkonnaruumi! Kas meie PRESIDENTiga on kõik hästi?

label: _SilphCo7Text_51e00
en: ROCKET GANG was after the MASTER BALL which will catch any #MON!
et: RAKETI KAMP jahtis MASTER PALLi, mis püüab iga #MONi kinni!

label: _CanceledMasterBallText
en: We canceled the MASTER BALL project because of ROCKET GANG.
et: Me lõpetasime MASTER PALLi projekti RAKETI KAMBA pärast.

label: _SilphCo7Text_51e23
en: It would be bad if ROCKET GANG took over SYLPH or our #MON!
et: See oleks halb, kui RAKETI KAMP võtaks üle SYLPHI või meie #MONi!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51e28
en: Wow! You chased off ROCKET GANG all by yourself?
et: Vau! Sa üksi ajasid RAKETI KAMBA minema?

label: _SilphCo7Text_51e46
en: You! It's really dangerous here! You came to save me? You can't!
et: Sina! Siin on tõesti ohtlik! Sa tulid mind päästma? Sa ei saa!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51e4b
en: Safe at last! Oh thank you!

label: _SilphCo7BattleText1
en: Oh ho! I smell a little rat!
et: Oh hoo! Ma haistan väikest rotti!

label: _SilphCo7AfterBattleText1
en: You won't find my BOSS by just scurrying around!
et: Sa ei leia minu BOSSI lihtsalt ringi siblides!

label: _SilphCo7BattleText2
en: You mistook me for a SYLPH worker?
et: Sa ajasid mind segamine SYLPHi töötajaga?

label: _SilphCo7AfterBattleText2
en: Despite your age, you are a skilled trainer!
et: Vaatamata Su eale oled Sa kogenud treener!

label: _SilphCo7BattleText3
en: I am one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
et: Ma olen üks neljast RAKETI VENNAST!

label: _SilphCo7AfterBattleText3
en: Doesn't matter. My brothers will repay the favor!
et: Pole oluline. Mu vennad osutavad vastuteene!

label: _SilphCo7BattleText4
en: A child intruder? That must be you!

label: _SilphCo7AfterBattleText4
en: Go on home before my BOSS gets ticked off!
et: Mine koju enne, kui mu BOSS Su vaibale kutsub!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ec3
en: <RIVAL>: Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here!
et: <RIVAL>: Hahahaa! Ma arvasin, et Sa oma nägu näitad, kui ma ootan siin!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ec3
en: I guess ROCKET GANG slowed you down! Not that I care!
et: Ma arvan, et RAKETI KAMP aeglustas Sind. Mitte, et mulle korda läheks!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ec3
en: I saw you in YAMABUKI, so I decided to see if you got better!
et: Ma nägin Sind YAMABUKIS, seega tahtsin näha, kas Sa oled paremaks saanud!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ec8
en: Oh ho! So, you are ready for BOSS ROCKET!
et: Oh hoo! Sa oled siis valmis RAKETI BOSSIKS!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ecd
en: You're not good enough to play with us big boys!
et: Sa pole piisavalt hea, et meiesuguste suurte poistega mängida!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ed2
en: I'm moving on up and ahead!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ed2
en: By checking my #DEX, I'm starting to see what's strong and how they evolve!
et: Vaadates oma #DEXi, ma hakkan nägema, mis on tugevad ja kuidas nad arenevad!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ed2
en: I'm going to the #MON LEAGUE to boot out the ELITE FOUR!
et: Ma lähen #MON LIIGASSE, et teha tuul alla VÕIMSALE NELIKULE!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ed2
en: I'll become the world's most powerful trainer!

label: _SilphCo7Text_51ed2
en: <PLAYER>, well good luck to you! Don't sweat it! Smell ya!
et: <PLAYER> edu Sulle. Ära siis pabla! Nägudeni!

label: _SilphCo8Text_565be
en: I wonder if SYLPH is finished...

label: _SilphCo8BattleText1
en: That's as far as you'll go!

label: _SilphCo8AfterBattleText1
en: If you don't turn back, I'll call for backup!
et: Kui Sa tagasi ei tõmba, ma kutsun abiväed!

label: _SilphCo8AfterBattleText2
en: So, what do you think of SYLPH BUILDING's maze?
et: Mis Sa arvad SYLPH HOONE labürindist?

label: _SilphCo8BattleText3
en: I am one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!

label: _SilphCo8AfterBattleText3
en: I'll leave you up to my brothers!

label: _SilphCo9Text_5d8e5
en: You look tired! You should take a quick nap!
et: Sa näed väsinud välja. Peaksid tegema väikse uinaku!

label: _SilphCo9BattleText1
en: Your #MON seem to adore you, kid!

label: _SilphCo9AfterBattleText1
en: If I had started as a trainer at your age...
et: Kui ma oleks ka Sinu vanusena treenerina alustanud...

label: _SilphCo9BattleText2
en: Your #MON have weak points! I can nail them!
et: Sinu #MONil on nõrkused! Ma saan neile pihta!

label: _SilphCo9AfterBattleText2
en: Exploiting weak spots does work! Think about element types!
et: Nõrkuste ärakasutamine töötab! Mõtle elemendi tüüpidele!

label: _SilphCo9BattleText3
en: I am one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!

label: _SilphCo9AfterBattleText3
et: Mu vennad maksavad mu eest kätte!

label: _UndergrdTunnelEntRoute6Text1
en: People often lose things in that UNDERGROUND PATH.
et: Inimesed tihti kaotavad oma asju MAAALUSELE TEELE.

label: _UndergroundPathEntRoute7Text1
en: I heard a sleepy #MON appeared near TAMAMUSHI.
et: Ma kuulsin, et üks unine #MON ilmus TAMAMUSHI ligidale.

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d773
en: I want to shop at the dept. store in TAMAMUSHI but...
et: Ma tahan poodelda TAMAMUSHI poes, aga...

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d773
en: There are so many rough looking people there.
et: Seal on liiga palju kahtlasi tegelasi.

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d778
en: ROCKET GANG had a secret hideout in TAMAMUSHI CITY?
et: RAKETI KAMBAL on salajane peidupaik TAMAMUSHI LINNAS?

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d77d
en: You're here to shop in TAMAMUSHI?

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d77d
en: Just step outside and head west!
et: Astu aga välja ja suundu läände!

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d782
en: The UNDERGROUND PATH goes beneath YAMABUKI and leads to CION.
et: MAAALUNE TEE läheb YAMABUKI alt ja viib CIONi.

label: _UGPathRoute7EntranceUnusedText_5d782
en: If you're heading to HANADA, go to the building across the road.
et: Kui suundud HANADA poole, siis mine üle tee ja läbi selle maja seal.

label: _UndergroundPathEntRoute8Text1
en: The dept. store in TAMAMUSHI has a great selection!

label: _VermilionCityText1
et: Me hoolime ja oleme saastega ettevaatlikud!

label: _VermilionCityText1
en: We've heard BETBETER multiplies in toxic sludge!
et: Me kuulsime, et GRIMER paljuneb mürgises lögas!

label: _VermilionCityTextDidYouSee
en: Did you see S.S. ANNE moored in the harbor?
et: Kas nägid, et S.S.ANNU on sildunud sadamas?

label: _VermilionCityTextSSAnneDeparted
en: She'll be back in about a year.
et: Ta tuleb tagasi umbes aasta pärast.

label: _SSAnneWelcomeText9
en: Excuse me, do you have a ticket?

label: _SSAnneNoTicketText
en: You need a ticket to get aboard.

label: _VermilionCityText4
en: I'm putting up a building on this plot of land.

label: _VermilionCityText14
en: A WANRIKY is stomping the land flat.

label: _VermilionCityText6
en: S.S.ANNU is a famous luxury cruise ship.
et: S.S.ANNU on kuulus luksuslik kruiisi laev.

label: _VermilionCityText6
en: We visit KUCHIBA once a year.
et: Me randume KUCHIBA sadamas korra aastas.

label: _VermilionCityText7
en: KUCHIBA CITY is the color of orange sunsets.
et: KUCHIBA LINN on oranžide loojangute värvi.

label: _VermilionCityText8
en: ROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a sleeping #MON.
et: TEE 12 võib olla suletud magava #MONi tõttu.

label: _VermilionCityText8
en: Detour through ROCK TUNNEL to CION TOWN.
et: Ümbersõit CIONI KÜLLA läbi KIVI TUNNELI.

label: _VermilionCityText11
et: #MONi FÄNNI KLUBI Kõik #MON fännid on oodatud!

label: _LTSurgePreBattleText
en: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here?
et: Kuule, tatt! Mida sa õige omastarust siin toimetad!

label: _LTSurgePreBattleText
en: You won't live long in combat! That's for sure!
et: Võitlusel sa kaua vastu ei pea! Seda ma sulle ütlen!

label: _LTSurgePreBattleText
en: I tell you kid, electric #MON saved me during the war!
et: Sõjas, ma räägin sulle, päästis elektri #MON mu elu!

label: _LTSurgePreBattleText
en: They zapped my enemies into paralysis!

label: _LTSurgePreBattleText
en: The same as I'll do to you!

label: _LTSurgePostBattleAdviceText
en: A little word of advice, kid!

label: _LTSurgeThunderbadgeInfoText
en: The ORANGEBADGE cranks up your #MON's SPEED!

label: _LTSurgeThunderbadgeInfoText
en: It also lets your #MON FLY any time, kid!
et: Lisaks võimaldab see su #MONidel LENNATA, millal aga tahad!

label: _LTSurgeThunderbadgeInfoText
et: Sa oled päris eriline kutt! Näe, võta see!

label: _TM24NoRoomText
en: Yo kid, make room in your pack!
et: Hei kutt, tee aga sellele ruumi!

label: _ReceivedThunderbadgeText
et: No olgu siis, võta see KOLLAMÄRK!

label: _VermilionGymBattleText1
en: When I was in the Army, MATIS was my strict CO!
et: Kui ma armees oli, siis MATIS oli mu ülemus... ta oli väga range!

label: _VermilionGymBattleText2
en: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good with electricity!
et: Ma olen küll kergekaallane aga ma olen elektriga osav!

label: _VermilionGymAfterBattleText2
en: MATIS said he hid door switches inside something!
et: MATIS ütles, et ta peitis ukse lülitid millegi sisse!

label: _VermilionGymBattleText3
en: This is no place for kids!

label: _VermilionGymAfterBattleText3
en: MATIS set up double locks! Here's a hint!
et: MATIS sättis ukstele kahekordsed lukud! Üks vihe sulle!

label: _VermilionGymAfterBattleText3
en: When you open the 1st lock, the 2nd lock is right next to it!
et: Kui sa avad esimese luku, siis teine on kohe selle kõrval!

label: _VermilionGymFanPreBattleText
en: MATIS has a nickname. People refer to him as the Lightning American!
et: MATISel on hüüdnimi. Teda kutsutakse Välgu Matiks

label: _VermilionGymFanPreBattleText
en: Birds and water #MON are at risk! Beware of paralysis too!
et: Linnud ja vee #MONid on ohus! Ning ära halvatust unusta!

label: _VermilionGymFanPreBattleText
en: You'll have to break a code to get to him!

label: _VermilionGymFanPostBattleText
et: Ossa! See võitlus oli küll elektrit täis!

label: _VermilionMartText2
en: There are evil people who will use #MON for criminal acts.
et: Maailmas on kurje inimesi, kes kasutavad #MONe oma kriminaalseteks tegudeks!

label: _VermilionMartText2
en: They also abandon #MON that they consider not to be popular or useful.
et: Nad hülgavad #MONid, kes nende arvates pole kasulikud või populaarsed.

label: _VermilionMartText3
en: I think #MON can be good or evil. It depends on the trainer.
et: #MONid võivad olla nii head kui kurjad. Sõltub treenerist.

label: _VermilionHouse2Text_560b1
et: Ütleme nii, et mulle meeldib kalastada!

label: _VermilionHouse2Text_560b6
en: Take this and fish, young one!

label: _VermilionHouse2Text_560bb
en: Fishing is a way of life!

label: _VermilionHouse2Text_560bb
en: From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, young one!
et: Nii merest, kui ka jõest, leia kala, suur sa!

label: _VermilionHouse2Text_560ca
en: You have no room for my gift!
et: Sul pole mu kingi jaoks ruumi!

label: _VermilionHouse1Text1
en: I'm getting my POPPO to fly a letter to YAMABUKI in the north!
et: Mu PIDGEY lendab ja viib kirja YAMABUKIsse!

label: _VermilionHouse1Text3
en: Dear PIPPI, I hope to see you soon.
et: Kallis CLEFAIRY, loodan, et näen sind peadselt.

label: _VermilionHouse1Text3
en: I heard YAMABUKI has problems with ROCKET GANG.
et: Kuulsin, et YAMABUKIs on probleeme RAKETI KAMBAGA.

label: _VermilionPokecenterText2
en: Even if they are the same level, #MON can have very different abilities.
et: Isegi samal tasemel olevatel #MONidel võivad olla erinevad võimed!

label: _VermilionPokecenterText2
en: A #MON raised by a trainer is stronger than one in the wild.
et: #MON, mis on kasvanud treeneri käe all on tugevam, kui metsik!

label: _VermilionPokecenterText3
en: My #MON was poisoned! It fainted while we were walking!
et: Mu #MON mürgitati! Ta minestas, kui jalutasime!

label: _VictoryRoad1BattleText1
en: I wonder if you are good enough for me!
et: Huvitav, kas oled piisavalt osav mu jaoks!

label: _VictoryRoad1AfterBattleText1
en: I never wanted to lose to anybody!
et: Ma ei oleks kunagi tahtnud kellelegi kaotada!

label: _VictoryRoad1BattleText2
en: I can see you're good! Let me see exactly how good!
et: Näen, et oled osav! Vaatame nüüd kui osav!

label: _VictoryRoad1AfterBattleText2
en: I concede, you're better than me!

label: _VictoryRoad2BattleText1
en: CHAMPION ROAD is the final test for trainers!

label: _VictoryRoad2AfterBattleText1
en: If you get stuck, try moving some boulders around!
et: Kui jääd toppama, siis proovi kivirahne liigutada!

label: _VictoryRoad2BattleText2
en: Ah, so you wish to challenge the ELITE FOUR?
et: Või, et soovid VÕIMSALE NELIKULE väljakutse esitada!

label: _VictoryRoad2AfterBattleText3
en: You earned the right to be on CHAMPION ROAD!

label: _VictoryRoad2BattleText4
en: If you can get through here, you can go meet the ELITE FOUR!
et: Kui saad siit mööda, siis võid minna VÕIMSA NELIKUGA kohtuma!

label: _VictoryRoad2AfterBattleText4
en: I can beat you when it comes to knowledge about #MON!
et: #MON alastes teadmistes alistan ma su kindlasti!

label: _VictoryRoad2BattleText5
et: Kas MEISTRITE TEE on liiga raske!

label: _VictoryRoad2AfterBattleText5
en: Many trainers give up the challenge here.

label: _VictoryRoad3BattleText2
en: I heard rumors of a child prodigy!

label: _VictoryRoad3AfterBattleText2
en: You beat SAKAKI of ROCKET GANG?

label: _VictoryRoad3BattleText3
en: I'll show you just how good you are!
et: Kohe saad teada kui osav sa tegelikult oled!

label: _VictoryRoad3AfterBattleText3
en: You showed me just how good I was!
et: Tundub, et sa näitasid mulle kui hea MINA olen!

label: _VictoryRoad3BattleText4
en: Only the chosen can pass here!
et: Ainult väljavalitu võib siit edasi minna!

label: _VictoryRoad3AfterBattleText4
en: All trainers here are headed to the #MON LEAGUE! Be careful!
et: Kõik treenerid siin suunduvad #MON LIIGA poole! Ole ettevaatlik!

label: _VictoryRoad3BattleText5
en: Trainers live to seek stronger opponents!

label: _VictoryRoad3AfterBattleText5
en: By fighting tough battles, you get stronger!

label: _ViridianCityText1
en: Those MONSTER BALLs at your waist! You have #MON!
et: Need KOLLI PALLid, mis sul vööl on! Sul on #MONe!

label: _ViridianCityText1
en: It's great that you can carry and use #MON any time, anywhere!
et: Tore, et sul on võimalik #MONe kaasaskanda ja suvalisel hetkel kasutada!

label: _ViridianCityText_19122
en: I wonder who the LEADER is?
et: Huvitav kes selle saali JUHT on?

label: _ViridianCityText_1914d
en: You want to know about the 2 kinds of caterpillar #MON?
et: Kas sa sooviksid teada kahest tõugulaadsest #MONist?

label: _ViridianCityText_19157
en: CATERPIE has no poison, but BEEDLE does.
et: CATERPIE pole mürgine, kuid BEEDLE on.

label: _ViridianCityText_19157
en: Watch out for its POISON STING!

label: _ViridianCityText_19175
en: Oh Grandpa! How did you fall asleep here, of all places!
et: Vanaisa! Kuidas sa siis nüüd siia magama jäid!

label: _ViridianCityText_19175
en: We have no other choice than to wait until he sobers up...
et: Meil pole muud võimalus, kui oodata, et ta ärkaks.

label: _ViridianCityText_1917a
en: When I go shop in NIBI CITY, I have to take the winding trail in TOKIWA FOREST.
et: Kui ma soovin minna NIBI LINNa poodi, pean minema läbi käänulise TOKIWA METSa

label: _ViridianCityText_19191
en: Aww... Hiccup... Wait a minute! Lissen to what I'm going to tell you!...
et: Nonii... (hõkk)... Otand nüüd! Pane nüüd tähele, mis sulle... ütlen...

label: _ViridianCityText_19191
en: Hey! Don't go away, I said!
et: Kuule! Ma ju ütlesin, et ära mine ära!

label: _ViridianCityText_191ca
en: Yawn! I must have dozed off in the sun.
et: (haigutus) Ma vist jäin päikse kätte magama.

label: _ViridianCityText_191ca
en: I had this dream about a SLEEP eating my dream. What's this? Where did this TM come from?
et: Ma nägin sellist und kus UNI sõi ära mu unenäo.

label: _ViridianCityText_191ca
en: This is spooky! Here, you can have this TM.
et: Mida see tähendab? Kust selline TM välja ilmus?

label: _TM42NoRoomText
en: You have too much stuff already.
et: Sul on juba liiga palju asju.

label: _ViridianCityText_1920a
en: Ugh... Seems like I was drunk!
et: Oeh... Tundub, et ma olin natuke purjakil!

label: _ViridianCityText_1920a
en: By the way, are you in a hurry?
et: Muide, ega sul ometi kiire pole?

label: _ViridianCityText_1920f
en: When you catch a #MON, #DEX is automatically updated.
et: Kui sa püüad kinni #MONi, siis #DEX uueneb automaatselt.

label: _ViridianCityText_1920f
en: What? Don't you know how to catch #MON?
et: Mida? Sa ei tea kuidas #MONe püüda?

label: _ViridianCityText_1920f
en: I'll show you how to then.

label: _ViridianCityText_19214
en: Time is money... Go along then.
et: Aeg on raha... niiet hakka juba astuma.

label: _ViridianCityText_19219
en: First, you need to weaken the target #MON.

label: _ViridianCityText8
en: TOKIWA CITY  is the color of green eternally.
et: TOKIWA LINN on rohelise igaviku värvi.

label: _ViridianCityText9
en: The more you have, the easier it is to fight!
et: Mida rohkem sul neid on seda lihtsam sul on võitlusel!

label: _ViridianCityText10
en: The battle moves of #MON are limited by their POWER POINTs, PP.
et: #MONid on võtete kasutamisel piiratud PP kogusega.

label: _ViridianCityText10
en: To replenish PP, rest your tired #MON at a #MON CENTER!
et: Et PP uuesti täis saada, külasta #MONi KESKUSt

label: _ViridianForestText1
en: I came here with some friends!

label: _ViridianForestBattleText1
en: Hey! You have #MON! Come on! Let's battle'em!
et: Hei! Sul on #MON! Tule! Võitleme nendega!

label: _ViridianFrstAfterBattleText1
en: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away!

label: _ViridianForestBattleText2
en: Yo! You can't jam out if you're a #MON trainer!
et: Yo! Sa ei saa jämmida kui oled #MONi treener!

label: _ViridianFrstAfterBattleText2
en: Darn! I'm going to catch some stronger ones!
et: Tõesti! Ma lähen ja püüan endale mõned tugevamad!

label: _ViridianForestBattleText3
en: Hey, wait up! What's the hurry?
et: Kuule, oota mind! Kuhu sul kiire?

label: _ViridianForestEndBattleText3
en: I give! You're good at this!
et: Ma annan alla! Sa oled ikka osav!

label: _ViridianFrstAfterBattleText3
en: Sometimes, you can find stuff on the ground!

label: _ViridianFrstAfterBattleText3
en: I'm looking for the stuff I dropped!
et: Praegu ma otsin neid asju mille ma ära kaotasin!

label: _ViridianForestText8
en: I ran out of # BALLs to catch #MON with!

label: _ViridianForestText8
et: Sa peaks alati rohkem kaasas kandma kui sul vaja on!

label: _ViridianForestText9
en: If you want to avoid battles, stay away from grassy areas!
et: Kui sa tahad madinast hoiduda, ära mine kõrge rohu sisse!

label: _ViridianForestText10
en: For poison, use ANTIDOTE! Get it at #MON MARTs!
et: Mürgi vastu kasuta VASTU MÜRKI! Seda müüakse #POES!

label: _ViridianForestText11
en: Contact DR.OHKIDO via PC to get your #DEX evaluated!
et: Saad oma #DEXi DR.OHKIDO poolt hinnata lasta ka arvuti kaudu!

label: _ViridianForestText12
en: No stealing of #MON from other trainers! Catch only wild #MON!
et: Teiste treenerite #MONe varastada ei tohi! Püüa ainult metsikuid #MONe!

label: _ViridianForestText13
et: Täie tervise juures on tal piisavalt jõudu, et põgeneda!

label: _ViridianForestText14
en: LEAVING TOKIWA FOREST NIBI CITY AHEAD
et: LAHKUTE TOKIWA METSAS NIBI LINN EES

label: _ViridianForestExitText1
en: Many #MON live only in forests  and caves.
et: Paljud #MONid elavad ainult metsas või koobastes.

label: _ViridianForestExitText1
en: You need to look everywhere to get different kinds!
et: Et kõiki erinevaid leida, pead igalt poolt otsima!

label: _ViridianForestExitText2
en: Have you noticed the bushes on the roadside?
et: Kas oled märganud neid põõsaid seal tee ääres?

label: _ViridianForestExitText2
en: They can be cut down by a special #MON move.
et: Neid saab ainult erilise #MON võttega lõigata.

label: _ViridianForestEntranceText1
en: Are you going to TOKIWA FOREST? Be careful, it's a natural maze!
et: Kas sa kavatsed TOKIWA METSa minna? Ole seal ettevaatlik, see on üks labürint!

label: _ViridianForestEntranceText2
en: KORATTA may be small, but its bite is wicked! Did you get one?
et: RATTATA on küll väike aga tema hammustus on vägev! Kas sa oled juba mõne leidnud?

label: _ViridianGymText_74ace
en: I planned to resurrect ROCKET GANG here!
et: Ma plaanisin just siin RAKETI KAMBA taasasutada!

label: _ViridianGymText_74ace
en: But, you have caught me again! So be it! This time, I'm not holding back!
et: Aga jälle, sa oled mulle jälile jõudnud! Seekord ma ennast tagasi ei hoia!

label: _ViridianGymText_74ace
en: Once more, you shall face SAKAKI, the greatest trainer!
et: Veel kord kohtad sa võitluses SAKAKIT, kõige paremat treenerit!

label: _ViridianGymText_74ad9
en: Having lost, I cannot face my underlings! ROCKET GANG is finished forever!
et: Ma ei saa enam kunagi oma käsilastele otsa vaadata, kuna kaotasin! RAKETTI KAMP on igavesti läbi!

label: _ViridianGymText_74ad9
en: I will dedicate my life to the study of #MON!
et: Oma edasise elu pühendan ma #MONide uurimisele!

label: _ViridianGymText_74ad9
en: Let us meet again some day! Farewell!

label: _ViridianGymText12
en: The GREENBADGE makes #MON of any level obey!
et: ROHEMÄRKI omades kuuletuvad kõik #MONid sõltumata tasemest!

label: _ViridianGymText12
en: It is evidence of your mastery as a #MON trainer!
et: See on tõestuseks su #MON meistriks olekul!

label: _ViridianGymText12
en: With it, you can enter the #MON LEAGUE!
et: Selle märgi ettenäitamisel saad sa #MON liigasse!

label: _ViridianGymText12
en: It is my gift for your #MON LEAGUE challenge!
et: See on minu kink sulle, sinu #MON LIIGA väljakutsel!

label: _TM27ExplanationText
en: TM27 is FISSURE! It will take out #MON with just one hit!
et: TM27 on MAALÕHE! See võte saab ühe hoobiga jagu suvalisest #MONist!

label: _TM27ExplanationText
en: I made it when I ran the GYM here, too long ago...
et: Ma lõin selle siis, kui siinset SAALI juhtisin, liiga kaua aega tagasi...

label: _TM27NoRoomText
en: You do not have space for this!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText1
en: Heh! You must be running out of steam by now!
et: Heh! Nüüdseks peaks sul juba toss väljas olema!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText1
en: You need power to keep up with our GYM LEADER!
et: Selleks, et meie SAALI JUHIGA sammu pidada, peab sul jaksu olema!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText2
en: Rrrroar! I'm working myself into a rage!
et: Uhh Uhh Urr! Ma kütan, et raevu!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText3
en: #MON and I, we make wonderful music together!
et: #MONid ja mina, me teeme koos imelist muusikat!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText3
en: Do you know the identity of our GYM LEADER?
et: Kas tead kes on meie SAALI JUHT?

label: _ViridianGymBattleText4
en: Karate is the ultimate form of martial arts!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText4
en: If my #MON were as good at Karate as I...
et: Kui mu #MONid oleks nii head karates kui mina...

label: _ViridianGymBattleText5
en: The truly talented win with style!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText6
en: I'm the KARATE KING! Your fate rests with me!
et: Mina olen KARATE KUNN! Su saatus on minu kätes!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText6
et: Sina ja #MONi LIIGA? Ära tee nalja!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText7
en: Your #MON will cower at the crack of my whip!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText7
et: Ootand nüüd! Ma olin lihtsalt hooletu!

label: _ViridianGymBattleText8
en: TOKIWA GYM was closed for a long time, but now our LEADER is back!
et: TOKIWA SAAL oli kaua suletud, kui nüüd me JUHT on naasnud!

label: _ViridianGymAfterBattleText8
en: You can go onto #MON LEAGUE only by defeating our GYM LEADER!
et: Sa saad minna #MON LIIGASSE ainult peale meie SAALI JUHI võitmist!

label: _ViridianGymText_74bd4
en: Even I don't know TOKIWA LEADER's identity!
et: Isegi mina ei tea kes on TOKIWA JUHI tegelikult!

label: _ViridianGymText_74bd4
en: This will be the toughest of all the GYM LEADERs!
et: See saab olema kõigist SAALI JUHI võitlustest karmim!

label: _ViridianGymText_74bd4
en: I heard that the trainers here like ground-type #MON!
et: Ma kuulsin, et siinsed treenerid eelistavad maa tüüpi #MONe!

label: _ViridianGymText_74bd9
en: Blow me away! SAKAKI was the GYM LEADER here?
et: Ära aja! SAKAKI oli meie SAALI JUHT?

label: _ViridianMartText1
en: Okay! Say hi to DR.OHKIDO for me!

label: _ViridianMartText4
en: Hey! You came from MASARA TOWN?
et: Kuule! Kas sa tulid just MASARA KÜLAst?

label: ViridianMartParcelQuestText
en: His order came in. Will you take it to him?
et: Ta pakk on kohale jõudnud. Kas viid selle talle?

label: _ViridianMartText2
et: Meie poes on müügil palju VASTUMÜRKe.

label: _ViridianMartText3
en: No! MEDICINEs are all sold out.

label: _ViridianHouseText1
en: Coming up with nicknames is fun, but hard.
et: Hüüdnimede väljamõtlemine on lõbus aga raske.

label: _ViridianHouseText1
en: Simple names are the easiest to remember.
et: Mida lihtsam nimi, seda kergemini jääb see meelde.

label: _ViridianPokeCenterText2
en: You can use that PC in the corner.
et: Sa võid kasutada seda arvutit seal nurgas.

label: _ViridianPokeCenterText2
en: The receptionist told me. So kind!
et: See tädi sealt leti tagant ütles mulle seda. Nii lahke!

label: _ViridianPokeCenterText3
en: There's a #MON CENTER in every town ahead.

label: _ViridianPokeCenterText3
en: They don't charge any money either!
et: Mis veel parem... Nende kasutamine on tasuta!

label: _SchoolText1
en: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my notes.
et: Huuh! Ma üritan oma märkmeid pähe õppida.

label: _SchoolText2
en: Be sure to read the blackboard carefully!
et: Ära unusta hoolikalt lugeda seda mis tahvlil on kirjas!

label: _WardenTeethText1
en: <PLAYER> gave the GOLD TEETH to the WARDEN!

label: _WardenTeethText2
en: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!

label: _WardenThankYouText
en: WARDEN: Thanks, kid! No one could understand a word that I said.
et: VALVUR: Aitäh! Keegi ei saanud muidu aru mida ma rääkisin.

label: _WardenThankYouText
en: I couldn't work that way. Let me give you something for your trouble.
et: Ma ei oleks saanud sedasi ju tööd teha. Las ma annan sulle midagi vaeva tasuks.

label: _HM04ExplanationText
en: It lets #MON move boulders when you're outside of battle.
et: Selle abil saavad #MONid rahne liigutada... seda võitluse väliselt muidugi.

label: _HM04ExplanationText
en: Oh yes, did you find SECRET HOUSE in SAFARI ZONE?
et: Ahjaa, kas sa leidsid üles SALA MAJA SAFARI ALAS?

label: _HM04ExplanationText
en: If you do, you win an HM!
et: Kui leiad, siis on sul võimalus võita HM!

label: _HM04ExplanationText
en: I hear it's the rare SURF HM.
et: Ma kuulsin, et see on haruldane HM SURF.
